entries.t: <FACE:00>Mistral disappeared…<NL><WAIT>What on earth is<NL>about to happen?
<FACE:08>Look outside!
<FACE:08>So many cables!
<FACE:12>The cables are getting<NL>into every Block!
<FACE:10>The net's cut, so it's<NL>wiring in each Block!
<FACE:00>Then what happens to<NL>the Cluster?<WAIT><FACE:0F>The Cluster's controls<NL>get taken completely…
<FACE:10>And then…<NL>escape is impossible…
<FACE:08>Whaaaaaat?!<NL><WAIT>You mean we stay like<NL>this forever?
<FACE:0F>Navi!<NL><WAIT>How long till they<NL>take control?
<FACE:53>Estimated time until<NL>total takeover:<WAIT>1 hour, 23 min, 12 sec<NL>± 56 seconds
<FACE:10>We have to do<NL>something by then…
<FACE:01>No choice. Let's go<NL>out and find Mistral!<WAIT><FACE:00>If we can stop it,<NL>things'll settle down<WAIT><FACE:0F>True…<NL><WAIT>Maybe better than just<NL>standing here idle…
<FACE:0F>Unfortunately, we<NL>can't get out of here
<FACE:03>No way!<NL><WAIT>Why not…?
<FACE:0F>Well, just watch…
<FACE:10>Navi!
<FACE:10>We're going outside!<NL>Prep for a spacewalk!
<FACE:53><SFX:6C>For any reason at all,<NL><DELAY:003C><DELAY:0026>going out is denied!<DELAY:001E><END>

<FACE:03>Huh…? Why not, Navi?<NL><WAIT>What do you mean, any<NL>reason at all?!<WAIT><FACE:53>All of my sensors…<NL><WAIT>cannot identify what<NL>surrounds the Cluster<WAIT>I cannot predict what<NL>going out would cause<WAIT>Sending humans out<NL>into such a place…<WAIT>I am programmed not<NL>to permit it<WAIT>Whatever the case,<NL>if a human's at risk…<WAIT>…I cannot permit it
<FACE:01>But… at this rate you<NL>shut down too!
<FACE:53>As long as I function,<NL>I cannot permit it.
<FACE:0F>It's no use, <PLAYER>!<NL>
<FACE:0F>Keeping humans safe<NL><WAIT>is the very core of<NL>Navi's program<WAIT>Changing it would take<NL>experts months!
<FACE:00>The program protecting<NL>humans endangers us?
<FACE:13>How careless of me…<NL><WAIT>To make management<NL>perfect…<WAIT>I left every final<NL>decision to Navi…<WAIT>And it backfires here<NL>of all places…
<FACE:10>A computer can't make<NL>calls like a human…
<FACE:01>So you're giving up<NL>already, Shiden?<NL>
<FACE:01>Waiting around like<NL>this fixes nothing!<WAIT><FACE:0F>I know that, but…<NL><WAIT>…Yeah
<FACE:12>Hold on!
<FACE:10>Navi!<NL><WAIT>If we keep waiting…<NL><WAIT>what happens then?<NL><WAIT>Give me a prediction!

<FACE:53>That I cannot predict…<NL><WAIT>Our situation admits<NL>of no analysis at all<WAIT>and there is far too<NL>little data to go on<WAIT><FACE:11>The Cluster's state…<NL><WAIT>There must be one<NL>thing you're sure of!<WAIT>Navi!!
<FACE:08>I see! I've got it!<NL>
<FACE:05>Somewhere in this room<NL><WAIT>there's gotta be a<NL>power monitor!<WAIT>Everyone, search!
<FACE:06>Not yet? Ugh, you're<NL>all so slow!
<FACE:0F>I want solid data<NL>Care to look too?
<FACE:0A>Try checking that<NL>monitor
<FACE:19>Ask the leader, I say
<FACE:14>No good askin' me,<NL>I dunno
<FACE:04>Huh?<NL><WAIT>The power's dropping!<NL><WAIT>Functions are falling<NL>more and more…
<FACE:03>At this rate it all<NL>shuts down in 3 days!

<FACE:0F>Locked in…<NL><WAIT>In a Cluster with no<NL>solar power…<WAIT>the life support keeps<NL>us going for…<WAIT>3 days…<NL><WAIT>So if we leave things<NL>as they are…<WAIT>in 3 days we're in<NL>danger for certain!
<FACE:53>That is quite correct.<NL><WAIT>However…<NL><WAIT>Sending you out to the<NL>unknown is no safer
<FACE:06>But if that brings new<NL>danger, it's no good!<WAIT><FACE:53>But if you go outside…<NL><WAIT>the chance of things<NL>improving is almost 0

<FACE:00>But it's not zero!<NL><WAIT>If it's not zero,<NL>it's worth a try!<WAIT>I want to see outside!<NL><WAIT>Even if I get hurt,<NL>I hate not knowing!<WAIT><FACE:01>If I don't do what I<NL>can, and it goes bad<WAIT>I'd surely regret it!<NL><WAIT>And I'd hate that!
<FACE:53>I too would like to<NL>test our chances!<WAIT>But I cannot defy an<NL>absolute prohibition!<WAIT>Sending humans into<NL>the unknown is…

<FACE:01>It's unknown, that's<NL>why I want to see!<WAIT>Calling it a mystery<NL>keeps it a mystery!<WAIT>You've got to dive in!<NL><WAIT>Just watching quietly<NL><WAIT>and waiting for the<NL>end? I can't do that!

<FACE:0F>Navi, even if the<NL>outcome's the same…<WAIT>no, even if it's worse<NL>the journey matters<WAIT>Humans have a thing<NL>called «curiosity»<WAIT>and nothing at all<NL>can stop it<WAIT><FACE:13>When I made you, I<NL>forgot to teach that…
<FACE:22>Navi…<NL><WAIT>Back then, you said<NL>something to me…<WAIT>That humans change and<NL>progress day by day…
<FACE:53>I greatly envy humans,<NL>who keep on changing<WAIT>Yet you are human:<NL>why won't you change?
<FACE:22>Those words changed me<NL>Even I could change!
<FACE:22>Now, Navi, it's your<NL>turn to change!
<FACE:53>Understood…<NL><WAIT>Redefining priority<NL>toward the unknown…
<FACE:53>Going outside…<NL><DELAY:0078><DELAY:0014><CLEAR>is hereby permitted…<NL><DELAY:003C><DELAY:000A><END>
<FACE:02>Yesss!<WAIT><FACE:07>You can talk sense!<WAIT><FACE:53>But I will come along
<FACE:03>Come along?!<WAIT><FACE:53>Well, rather than me…<NL><WAIT>a Medabot I operate<NL>will accompany you<WAIT>Through that Medabot<NL>I will speak with you<WAIT><FACE:00>A Medabot?

<FACE:53><SFX:6E>Built in the Computer<NL><DELAY:0078><DELAY:000A>Block: a navi Medabot<DELAY:0078><DELAY:0008><CLEAR>This is «Navico»<NL><DELAY:003C><DELAY:003A><CLEAR>She'll join the team<NL><DELAY:0078><DELAY:0006>in Robattles to help<DELAY:003C><DELAY:002A><END>
<FACE:08>What?!<NL>This Medabot?<WAIT><FACE:07>So cuuute!
<FACE:0F>Hold on a minute, Navi<NL>Did that Block have<WAIT>any development gear?!

<FACE:53>Truth is, the human<NL>heart was a riddle…<WAIT>In secret I kept<NL>trying to grasp it<WAIT>I kept researching it<NL><WAIT>Especially Medabots,<NL>gripping kids' hearts<WAIT>Machines like me, yet<NL>why so different?<WAIT>I sought to solve that<NL>riddle…
<FACE:05>So you built a Medabot<NL>you could link with?<WAIT><FACE:53>That is so…<NL><WAIT>But I never found a<NL>reason to wake it…<WAIT>Not until a chance<NL>like this one came…
<FACE:0F>Even so…<NL>Building a Medabot on<WAIT>your own is already…
<FACE:02>Let it go, Shiden<NL>We got permission…
<FACE:02>Besides, this Medabot…<NL><WAIT>Its specs look decent<NL>
<FACE:22>…
<FACE:01>There's no time to go<NL>anywhere right now!
<FACE:56><SFX:6F>Nice to meet you<DELAY:003C><DELAY:0035><NL>I'm Navico<DELAY:003C><END>
<FACE:54>Navico joined the<NL>team!
